title: skills: teach the declared action override (an installed package's action renamed, hidden or adjusted through its .custom pair) and its access-widening refusal
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPxYq1wQmUNWvMZkC

Filing gate: ③ a `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line on PR #30497 (#30065), which the seat files before ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets lane and grade. Suggested-grade: p3.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `declared action override skill`, `declared_action_widens_access` → none. **New.**
type: Docs

## What changes when PR #30497 lands

- `action` joins the declared-override types (ADR-0146 D9): an installed package's action can be overridden through its paired `<base>.custom` package with `overrides: { package, basedOn }`, served wherever the action is drawn or run, and removed to restore the base.
- An override that widens who may run the action is refused at save: `requiredPermissions` may only grow, `ai.exposed` may not go `false` → `true`, `requiresConfirmation` may not go `true` → `false` (rule `declared_action_widens_access`, 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`). Behaviour fields (`type`, `target`, `body`, `params`, `label`, `visible`, …) may be replaced whole.

## Wanted

- [ ] `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (and any reference page it routes to for overrides) teaches the action override next to the existing flow/view override guidance, with the three widening refusals and the fact that the override's body runs for the people who could already run the base action.
- [ ] The package's skill evals exercise it if the skill's convention requires it.

Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/**` is a governed surface). Links: #30065, PR #30497.
